Questions About Visiting

The practical things patients ask before booking, answered plainly.

Request an appointment
How much does it cost?

Fees are discussed openly and clearly before any treatment, with no hidden charges. The cost depends on the condition and the treatment needed. If you are worried about cost, please raise it. It is a normal and fair question, and it will be answered plainly.

Can I bring someone with me?

Yes. You are welcome to bring a family member into the consultation. Many patients find it easier to have someone with them to listen and to help remember what was said.

I live outside Peshawar. Do I have to travel for every visit?

No. An evening online video consultation is available Monday to Saturday. This is useful for patients travelling from Mardan, Charsadda, Nowshera, Swat, Swabi, Kohat, Bajaur and further. Your first visit or your surgery may need to be in person, but many follow-up checks can be done online.

Clinic in Khyber Bazar, Peshawar

The clinic is in Khyber Bazar, in the middle of Peshawar, and is easy to reach by rickshaw or taxi from Saddar, University Road and the Ring Road.
